question: In which of the following are ovules NOT enclosed by any ovary wall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gymnosperm.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Gymnosperm**

__
 
• The Gymnosperms are the plants in which the ovules remain exposed before and after fertilization and** are not enclosed by ovary wall.**
 
• **Cycas, Pinus** and **Ginkgo **are the examples of Gymnosperm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

** Pteridophytes**

 
• Pteridophytes are the **first terrestrial plants** to possess vascular tissues – **xylem and phloem**.
 
• Pteridophytes have independent sporophyte.

**Algae**

 
• **Algae are chlorophyll-bearing, simple, thalloid, autotrophic, and largely aquatic (both fresh water and marine) organisms.** They occur in a variety of other habitats: moist stones, soils, and wood.
 
• The form and size of algae are highly variable, ranging from colonial forms like Volvox and the filamentous forms like Ulothrix and Spirogyra. A few of the marine forms such as kelps, form massive plant bodies.
 
• Algae can be classified into three major types on the basis of pigment present in them Chlorophyceae, Phaeophyceae, and Rhodophyceae.

**Angiosperm**

 
• Angiosperms are the most advanced and widely distributed plants in the plant kingdom.
 
• **Angiosperms have seeds enclosed within their fruits, in contrast to gymnosperms which have naked seeds.** Angiosperms are found in almost all types of habitats and include trees, shrubs, vines, etc. Angiosperms are flowering plants and have four whorls - two accessory whorls - calyx and corolla and two essential whorls - androecium and gynoecium. Angiosperms reproduce through sexual reproduction. The two essential whorls of the flower are involved in sexual reproduction in angiosperms.
